## Summary

Briefly describe the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation

Why is this feature important? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

How would this feature work? Describe any ideas you have.

## Alternatives

Have you considered any alternatives?

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, mockups, or examples if relevant. If the idea is about a new
statistics view, describe the question it should answer — the plugin aims to
answer questions the host cannot, not to duplicate what OpenCode already shows.
